request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only two things. The big red smock becomes dull mid-brown hide, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows and two darker stitched patches. His skin becomes a darker forest green, colour #3d6a2a with #264219 shadows: clearly green, not grey, not blue, the face still clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the moss, face, beard, tusks, wrist bands, stone club, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
